name: web-research
description: Token-efficient web research: searches run in cheap Haiku subagents with explicit limits - a fast WebSearch/WebFetch researcher and a real-browser researcher (Playwright) for JavaScript-heavy or interactive pages - so raw page content never reaches the main conversation.

enforce.title: Block direct web tools in the main conversation
enforce.description: When on, WebSearch and WebFetch called from the main conversation are blocked with a message to delegate to web-research:researcher. Subagents are never blocked.

browser_headed.title: Show the browser window
browser_headed.description: When on, the browser-researcher runs Chromium in a visible window instead of headless - use it to log in to a site once; the profile is kept for later sessions.
